items.prompt: White to move. Can the black king stop the white pawn on h2 from becoming a queen? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: With best play the result for the side to move is a win.

hints: Count how many moves the pawn needs to reach the last rank. (From its starting rank it may move two squares at once on its first move.)
Count how many king moves the chasing king needs to get to the pawn's last-rank square. A king moves one square in any direction.
Compare the two counts, and remember who is to move: if the chasing king arrives in time, it captures the pawn or the new queen.
items.explain: No. With best play the tablebase result is a win for white, so the pawn cannot be stopped.
